Symptom: The fictional Atlas order export stops after selecting a date range.
Question: Does the failure affect every date range or only the current month?

Attempt: Reload the export page and retry the same date range.
Result: The same timeout occurs. Recovery has not been verified.

Decision: Keep the last verified report available while investigating.
Blocker: The current-month export is still unavailable.
Action (Maya): Test one completed week and record the result.

Attempt: Export a completed week.
Result: The small export downloads, but full-month recovery is unverified.
Action (Unassigned): Confirm impact and assign the next investigation owner.
An unstructured observation can still be searched. It is not automatically turned into an action or resolution.
